summary: Focus on major cosmic legends and well-known deities (Lord Shiva, Vishnu) rather than obscure folk tales.
Hook viewers within the first 10 seconds; current intro drop-offs occur under 15 seconds on weak videos.
Use clean, bilingual titles (Hindi story name + English search keyword) to improve discoverability.
Aim for 4 to 6 minute detailed narrative scripts; deeper storytelling (like Samudra Manthan) drives high retention.
Avoid overly niche or confusing historical settings (e.g., 1920 North Indian village) that turn off audience interest.
Keep titles under 60 characters and remove excess emojis to look authoritative.
